verdict.rationale: Clerky documents its own signing capability: document sets bundle 'documents, signatures, and filings,' users 'sign documents on Clerky,' and 'Clerky handles signing.' It also supports inviting collaborators to a document set. However, nothing shows a founder sending an arbitrary document to multiple signers, controlling signing order or routing, or what makes the signatures legally binding. Signing appears confined to Clerky's own templated paperwork such as formations. missing for 10: sending arbitrary or uploaded documents for signature, multi-recipient signer configuration, routing or signing-order controls, documentation of legal validity and audit trail for signatures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
